summary: Section Types Catalog Refactoring - All tests passed. Backend API endpoints for section-types CRUD are working correctly. Frontend SectionModal now uses a dropdown populated from /api/academic/section-types instead of free text input. Backward compatibility auto-assigns section_type_id to existing sections.
passed_tests: GET /api/academic/section-types returns catalog (A, B, C, D, E, F, ÚNICA)
Section types have correct labels (ÚNICA not UNICA)
Section types are returned in correct order (A=1, B=2, ..., ÚNICA=7)
Creating section without section_type_id fails with 422 validation error
Duplicate section type in same grade is rejected with 400 error
Existing sections get section_type_id auto-assigned (backward compatibility)
Sections response includes all required fields (id, nombre, grado_id, etc.)
Creating section with invalid section_type_id fails with 400
Creating section with invalid grado_id fails with 400
Frontend: SectionModal shows dropdown for 'Tipo de Sección'
Frontend: Dropdown contains all 7 section types from catalog
Frontend: Creating new section using dropdown works correctly
Frontend: Helper text shows 'Ej: A, B, C, ÚNICA (del catálogo centralizado)'
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - section_types catalog is properly implemented with default seeding
Backward compatibility is well handled - auto-migration of existing sections on GET
Duplicate validation correctly prevents same section type in same grade
Frontend properly fetches section types and populates dropdown
seed_data_creation: Created test section 'C' in 'Inicial - 3 años' grade during testing, then cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Section types catalog refactoring is complete. The /api/academic/section-types endpoint returns 7 default types (A-F, ÚNICA). Sections are now created using section_type_id instead of free text 'nombre'. The SectionModal in AcademicSettingsPage.jsx uses a dropdown with data-testid='section-type-select'. Backward compatibility auto-assigns section_type_id to existing sections based on their 'nombre' field.

backend_section_types_endpoint.GET /api/academic/section-types: Returns catalog with 7 types (A, B, C, D, E, F, ÚNICA)
backend_section_types_endpoint.auto_seeding: Default catalog is created if empty

backend_sections_endpoint.POST /api/academic/sections: Now requires section_type_id instead of nombre
backend_sections_endpoint.duplicate_validation: Prevents same section type in same grade

frontend_section_modal.dropdown: Shows 'Tipo de Sección' dropdown instead of text input
frontend_section_modal.helper_text: Shows 'Ej: A, B, C, ÚNICA (del catálogo centralizado)'
